def _render_list_item(renderer: 'BaseRenderer', parent: Dict[str, Any],
    item: Dict[str, Any], state: 'BlockState') ->str:
    leading = parent['leading']
    children = item.get('children', [])
    
    if not children:
        return leading + '\n'
    
    # Render all children
    text_parts = []
    for child in children:
        text_parts.append(renderer.render_token(child, state))
    
    text = ''.join(text_parts)
    text = strip_end(text)
    
    # Add leading to first line and indent subsequent lines
    lines = text.split('\n')
    indent = ' ' * len(leading)
    
    result = leading + lines[0]
    for line in lines[1:]:
        if line or lines.index(line) < len(lines) - 1:  # preserve empty lines
            result += '\n' + (indent + line if line else '')
        else:
            result += '\n'
    
    result += '\n'
    return result
